summary: log-taker@0.0.7: shell execution via child_process requires human review
details: index.js imports child_process and invokes execSync with bash and zsh shell strings (around lines 315 and 331). The pattern of spawning interactive shells from a package named 'log-taker' is unusual and warrants human review, but the available evidence does not include the literal command strings, network destinations, credential reads, or lifecycle-hook bindings needed to confirm an installer-side attack. There is no traced exfiltration endpoint, no read of installer-secret paths, and no confirmed install-time auto-execution path. Disposition is review pending verification of where these shell calls fire (lifecycle hook vs. user-invoked CLI) and what commands they execute.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
